'''Tursturin''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]]-produced alloy that generated gigajoules of energy when heated above 4,000 degrees. [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] had [[thermo-converter]]s on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] built from tursturin in order to provide the multitude of energy needed to keep the city operational. In general, thermo-converters were not constructed of tursturin since the energy required to create the heat was greater than the energy produced. However, Bespin's free heat and the size of the thermo-converter's surface area made the use of tursturin cost-effective.<ref name="GG2" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> industrial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] tried to steal [[Corellian Technologies/Legends|Corellian Technologies]]' tursturin supplies. As the company did not want to involve local or Imperial law enforcement agencies to avoid questions about the tursturin's provenance, they hired an independent strike team to destroy the saboteurs and their stronghold.<ref name="SWG:TSAbS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Tursturin Supply Attacked by Saboteurs}} on Corellia</ref>
